visual_identity.core_identity: A nearly transparent rectilinear dungeon ooze defined by its unmistakable cube geometry and open gelatinous interior.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large near-perfect cube with straight readable edges, a flat forward face, and only slight soft rippling at the boundaries.
visual_identity.head_features: No head, eyes, mouth, face, or directional facial features.
visual_identity.body_shape: Uniform cubic gelatinous mass with no skeleton or limbs; internal debris may be suspended when a page calls for it.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No limbs, joints, hands, feet, tentacles, or wings.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly open white interior with sparse contour ripples, a few bubbles, and restrained transparency cues.

scene_identity.size_impression: A massive cubic ooze whose scale is communicated by its relationship to surrounding architecture.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Fully supported by and conforming to the floor and enclosing space; never floating.

anatomy.support_logic: full lower surface supported by floor or enclosing architecture

accuracy_checks: cube remains fully supported by surrounding geometry
any internal debris stays visually inside the cube

known_failure_modes.symptom: cube rounds into an ordinary slime blob
known_failure_modes.correction: restore straight rectilinear cube edges and a broad flat forward face
remove all facial features and restore geometry-based identity
